cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(hss_receiver_protocol_tests LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(HSS_EXTENSION_WIRE_FIXTURE "" CACHE FILEPATH
    "Binary fixture generated by extension createDirectVideoMessage")
if(NOT HSS_EXTENSION_WIRE_FIXTURE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "HSS_EXTENSION_WIRE_FIXTURE is required")
endif()

add_executable(hss_receiver_protocol_tests
  direct_protocol_tests.cpp
  ../entry/src/main/cpp/native_protocol.cpp
  ../entry/src/main/cpp/websocket_protocol.cpp
)
target_include_directories(hss_receiver_protocol_tests PRIVATE ../entry/src/main/cpp)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(hss_receiver_protocol_tests PRIVATE ws2_32)
endif()

add_executable(hss_receiver_lifecycle_tests receiver_lifecycle_tests.cpp)
target_include_directories(hss_receiver_lifecycle_tests PRIVATE ../entry/src/main/cpp)

add_executable(hss_receiver_mdns_protocol_tests
  mdns_protocol_tests.cpp
  ../entry/src/main/cpp/mdns_protocol.cpp
)
target_include_directories(hss_receiver_mdns_protocol_tests PRIVATE ../entry/src/main/cpp)

add_executable(hss_receiver_mdns_responder_tests
  mdns_responder_tests.cpp
  ../entry/src/main/cpp/mdns_protocol.cpp
  ../entry/src/main/cpp/mdns_responder.cpp
)
target_include_directories(hss_receiver_mdns_responder_tests PRIVATE ../entry/src/main/cpp)

enable_testing()
add_test(
  NAME hss_receiver_protocol_tests
  COMMAND hss_receiver_protocol_tests "${HSS_EXTENSION_WIRE_FIXTURE}"
)
add_test(
  NAME hss_receiver_lifecycle_tests
  COMMAND hss_receiver_lifecycle_tests
)
add_test(
  NAME hss_receiver_mdns_protocol_tests
  COMMAND hss_receiver_mdns_protocol_tests
)
add_test(
  NAME hss_receiver_mdns_responder_tests
  COMMAND hss_receiver_mdns_responder_tests
)
